title: 第263章 成道之别第262章 愧疚之事
content_zh:
后来陈阳突破洞玄境界苏醒于世，接收完所有分身记忆后，他做的第一件事，就是前去查看了正怀有身孕，于龙隐峰洞府中闭关静养的东方盈彩。
长子遇害亡故一事，对她这位母亲而言无疑是一份沉重的打击。
这种事情也隐瞒不得，以东方盈彩这般聪慧的女子，只要见到了返家的杨元鸿，便定然能够猜到发生了什么。
所以为了尽可能不让此事影响到其腹中的胎儿的成长，陈阳便是以自身真玄为尚未出生的杨玄苍的心脉做了一番护持。
破境洞玄之后他所拥有的灵珠数量翻了倍，在此番行法之时，也是特别关注了这位龙君次子的情况。
杨玄苍胎儿期间的气血确实壮硕，几乎是完美继承了其父杨元鸿的肉身天赋。
但似乎因为阴阳相济的缘故，这个孩子的气息整体都是中正平和之态，并没有诞生如杨元鸿当年一般的血气野性。
陈阳随后唤出多个灵珠进行感应，希望能够帮助杨玄苍炼化其中一枚。
但因为那份关键天赋的缺失，这些灵珠都只是在东方盈彩身周环绕了几圈，没能进入到杨玄苍的体内。
此事强求不得，陈阳在几番尝试之后也只得作罢，打算等以后有了其他机会，再多杨元鸿和东方盈彩二人作些弥补。
不过，他终究是低估了东方盈彩的敏锐，在收起术法打算离去之时，后者便是直接张口问他，自己的丈夫和孩子是不是遇到了危险。
陈阳虽心有不忍，却还是将上修降法之时发生的一切，如实告知了对方，并表示日后一定会对他们这一脉的孩子做出补偿。
然而让陈阳没想到的是，东方盈彩在此事之上的坚强与理性，也超乎了自己的想象。
她当即便表示自家这一脉不需要仙尊的优待，并说出了那句与杨灵清如出一辙，让陈阳感到无比揪心的“杨氏无人不可死，我儿玄舟，亦不是例外”。
接下来的交谈中，关于杨玄舟亡故之事，东方盈彩也没有过问太多细节，只与陈阳询了一言：“仙尊，此番昆墟秘境之行，我儿玄舟，勇否？”
这句话对于陈阳的触动可谓是相当之深，让他不禁显化出人形灵体，与东方盈彩执过一礼，正声回应道：“玄舟此行，以肉身擎天山、以术法降天雷、以仁心护弟妹，诚可谓，勇武无双！”
得了这份答复，东方盈彩便也露出欣慰之容，流下了两行泪水，直言谢过仙尊。
此番交谈过后，陈阳便唤动空间道法，将吴桐接入龙隐峰陪同照看东方盈彩，随后也没再多做逗留打扰，抽身离去。
破境洞玄，仙道境界功至尊者之位，于陈阳的道途修炼而言，本该是一份大喜之事。
但杨灵清与杨玄舟二人相继亡故的消息，却是让他心中难有半点欣喜之念，只会更感痛心与惋惜，心念自己若是能早些破境，若是能够早些发现那上修降法的目标，是否就能避免这样的惨剧发生...

以当时的状态而言，陈阳的心境无疑是十分动荡且纷乱的。
那也是他唯一一次，在心生执念之后，有了一种道心动摇之感，开始怀疑自己所做的一切是否真的有意义。
而最终让陈阳心境再次平复下来，并扫清道心杂念的，便是当时尚在云栖梧腹中的杨元真。
当日离开龙隐峰后，陈阳便再度去往了神朔峰上。
修士修为越高，怀胎时间也就越久，故而云栖梧在那时虽然已经怀有身孕近两年之久，但腹中胎儿也还处于成长育化阶段。
也正因如此，杨元真才算等到了自家仙尊破境苏醒，得到了在胎儿阶段炼化灵珠的机会。
在初见杨元真时，陈阳便一眼看出了这个孩子的不俗之处，她那份一身天然的禀赋，在那时候就已经开始显露。
这次都不用陈阳主动行法，只是感受到了杨元真的一抹气息，他体内的那些灵珠便都争先恐后的跳脱而出，想要入驻进这个孩子体内。
其中反应最快的那枚灵珠抢得了先机，成功进入到了杨元真的体内，并在陈阳的真玄融炼之下，逐渐显化为了玉刀的雏形。
见得这等奇异景象，再加上杨元真本身的那一份天然气息，陈阳的内心也慢慢缓和平静了下来。
起初陈阳还不曾察觉此中玄机，直到事后复盘回想，他方才意识到，当日是杨元真身上的那份天然之息，消解了自己心中的郁结愤懑之念，继而帮助自己清除了一份日后修行的隐患。
如此算起来，陈阳倒还欠着杨元真这孩子一份人情了。
“气脉形态极佳、气节无垢、灵气流转井然有序、气府稳固、灵力充盈、识海完备无瑕，实属上上之姿！”
时间回到此刻的现世，在陈阳的意识探查之下，杨元真入道后所有的修炼体征都相当稳定，灵气走过的每一处关窍，都在有条不紊的运转，整体看来，颇具一份浑然通泰的意境。
又因为本身修行无关因果气运，杨元真的这次破境也没有引来任何异象显现。
她就像是一个与此方世界完全无关的世外之人，所修所得亦不在此界大道的约束范围之内。
在修为进展方面，杨元真也不像杨元鸿过去那般，刚入道就一个劲儿的猛涨。
从凝聚气府到现在，杨元真的境界也只在聚气二重与三重之间，整体的精进速度十分平稳，没有较大的起伏波动。
而其本人的神识，如今也正处于一种完全放空、不为外物所扰的状态。
“灵睿，我对杀道之法领悟不深，看不出元真的道途轨迹，你可能与我说说其中门道？”

陈阳感应不出个所以然，便与一旁的杨灵睿问道。
后者闻言便是露出一抹苦笑之色，答道：“回仙尊，不瞒您说，真儿所修功法虽然是我传授于她，但关于她此刻踏上的道途，我也是只知其然而不知其所以然。”
“以我的杀道真意来看，真儿所修并非是杀道正路，而更像一种旁门之道，杀性不重、杀意不强、杀心更是一点都没有，似乎是有些不符合杀道常理。”
“但我随后细想，这孩子既怀抱玉刀而生，又天生暗合杀道真意所向，或许她本身，就是灵元杀道于沧澜洲内孕育而生的一道具象之形。”
：8xiaoshuo。：wap.8xiaoshuo
content_en:
Later, Chen Yang broke through the Dongxuan realm and woke up. After receiving all the memories of his clones, the first thing he did was to check on Dongfang Yingcai, who was pregnant and was recuperating in the Longyin Peak cave.
The murder of her eldest son was undoubtedly a heavy blow to her mother.
This kind of thing cannot be concealed. A smart woman like Dongfang Yingcai will definitely be able to guess what happened as long as she sees Yang Yuanhong returning home.
Therefore, in order to prevent this matter from affecting the growth of the fetus in his belly as much as possible, Chen Yang used his own true essence to protect the heart of the unborn Yang Xuancang.
After breaking through the cave, the number of spirit beads he owned doubled. During this practice, he also paid special attention to the situation of the second son of the Dragon Lord.
Yang Xuancang's Qi and blood were indeed strong during the fetal period, and he almost perfectly inherited the physical talent of his father Yang Yuanhong.
But it seems that because of the harmony of yin and yang, the child's aura is generally righteous and peaceful, and he does not have the wild blood and energy like Yang Yuanhong did back then.
Chen Yang then summoned several spirit beads for induction, hoping to help Yang Xuancang refine one of them.
But due to the lack of that key talent, these spirit beads only circled around Dongfang Yingcai a few times and failed to enter Yang Xuancang's body.
This matter could not be forced, so Chen Yang had to give up after several attempts, planning to wait until there were other opportunities in the future for Yang Yuanhong and Dongfang Yingcai to make amends.
However, he underestimated Dongfang Yingcai's acumen after all. When he put away his magic and was about to leave, the latter directly asked him if his husband and children were in danger.
Although Chen Yang couldn't bear it, he still truthfully told the other party everything that happened when he was cultivating the law and said that he would definitely make compensation to the children of their lineage in the future.
However, what Chen Yang didn't expect was that Dongfang Yingcai's strength and rationality in this matter exceeded his imagination.
She immediately said that her family did not need preferential treatment from the Immortal Lord, and said the same sentence as Yang Lingqing, which made Chen Yang feel extremely heartbroken: "No one in the Yang family is immune to death, and my son Xuanzhou is no exception."
In the following conversation, Dongfang Yingcai did not ask too many details about Yang Xuanzhou's death. He only asked Chen Yang: "Immortal Lord, is my son Xuanzhou brave during this trip to the secret realm of Kunxu?"
This sentence touched Chen Yang so deeply that he couldn't help but manifest a humanoid spirit body, saluted Dongfang Yingcai, and responded sternly: "Xuanzhou has used his body to hold up the Tianshan Mountain, used his magic to bring down thunder, and protected his younger brothers and sisters with his benevolence. It can be said that he is unparalleled in bravery!"
After receiving this reply, Dongfang Yingcai looked relieved, shed two lines of tears, and thanked the Immortal.
After this conversation, Chen Yang summoned the space method and connected Wu Tong to Longyin Peak to accompany and look after Dongfang Yingcai. Then he left without any further interruption.
Breaking the realm of Dongxuan and becoming the supreme master of the Immortal Realm should have been a great joy for Chen Yang's cultivation.
However, the news that Yang Lingqing and Yang Xuanzhou died one after another made it difficult for him to feel any joy in his heart. He only felt more sad and regretful. He wondered if he could have broken through the situation earlier, if he could have discovered the goal of ascending the cultivation and subjugation method earlier, whether such a tragedy could have been avoided...
Judging from the state at that time, Chen Yang's state of mind was undoubtedly very turbulent and chaotic.
That was also the only time that after becoming obsessed with something, he felt shaken in his Taoist heart and began to doubt whether everything he did was really meaningful.
In the end, it was Yang Yuanzhen who was still in Yun Qiwu's belly who finally calmed Chen Yang down again and cleared his mind.
After leaving Longyin Peak that day, Chen Yang went to Shenshuo Peak again.
The higher the monk's cultivation level, the longer the pregnancy will take, so Yun Qiwu isAlthough she had been pregnant for nearly two years at that time, the fetus in her belly was still in the stage of growth and development.
Because of this, Yang Yuanzhen finally waited until his Immortal Lord broke through the realm and woke up, and got the opportunity to refine the spirit beads in the fetal stage.
When he first met Yang Yuanzhen, Chen Yang could see the remarkable qualities of this child at a glance. Her natural talents had already begun to show at that time.
This time, Chen Yang didn't need to take the initiative to perform the method. He just felt Yang Yuanzhen's breath, and the spirit beads in his body rushed out, trying to settle in the child's body.
The spirit bead that reacted the fastest among them seized the opportunity and successfully entered Yang Yuanzhen's body. Under the fusion of Chen Yang's Zhenxuan, it gradually manifested into the prototype of the jade sword.
Seeing this strange scene, coupled with Yang Yuanzhen's natural aura, Chen Yang's heart gradually relaxed and calmed down.
At first, Chen Yang was not aware of the mystery. It was not until he reflected on it afterwards that he realized that it was the natural breath in Yang Yuanzhen that day that dispelled the frustration and resentment in his heart, and then helped him eliminate a hidden danger in his future practice.
Calculating it this way, Chen Yang still owes Yang Yuanzhen a favor.
"The shape of the Qi veins is excellent, the Qi knots are clean, the spiritual energy flows in an orderly manner, the Qi palace is stable, the spiritual power is full, and the sea of consciousness is complete and flawless. It is truly a superior appearance!"
Time returns to the current world at this moment. Under Chen Yang's consciousness exploration, all the physical signs of Yang Yuanzhen's cultivation after entering Taoism are quite stable. Every key orifice that the spiritual energy passes through is operating in an orderly manner. Overall, it has a peaceful and peaceful artistic conception.
And because his own practice has nothing to do with cause and effect, Yang Yuanzhen's breakthrough did not cause any strange phenomena to appear.
She is like an outsider who has nothing to do with this world, and what she has achieved is not within the constraints of this world.
In terms of cultivation progress, Yang Yuanzhen is not like Yang Yuanhong in the past, whose cultivation has skyrocketed as soon as he entered the Tao.
From Qi Condensation to the present, Yang Yuanzhen's state is only between the second and third levels of Qi Condensation. The overall speed of progress is very stable, without major fluctuations.
And his own spiritual consciousness is now in a state of being completely empty and not disturbed by external objects.
"Lingrui, I don't have a deep understanding of the method of killing, and I can't see the trajectory of Yuan Zhen's path. Can you tell me about it?"
Chen Yang couldn't figure out the reason, so he asked Yang Lingrui beside him.
Hearing this, the latter showed a wry smile and replied: "Hui Xianzun, to be honest with you, although I taught Zhen'er the skills she practiced, I only know about the path she is embarking on now, but I don't know why."
"From my perspective of the true meaning of the way of killing, what Zhen'er cultivates is not the right way of killing, but more like a side path. The murderous nature is not heavy, the intention to kill is not strong, and the murderous intention is not at all. It seems to be somewhat inconsistent with the common sense of the way of killing."
"But then I thought about it carefully. This child was born with a jade sword in her arms, and she was also born with the true intention of the Killing Dao. Perhaps she herself is the shape of a weapon born from the Lingyuan Killing Dao in Canglan Continent."
:8xiaoshuo. ：wap.8xiaoshuo
